title: ProjectionKillSwitchSetV1
description: One versioned set of public-projection kill switches (docs/v5/market-safety.md, sections "Kill switch" and "發布閘門"). Each switch can be closed independently: one fact revision, one company's (instrument's) character projection, one market session's character projection, one trading date's post-close paper-action reveal, one 今日五幕 act, all ticker-specific share cards and short videos, or the whole current-market projection. Rule a consumer must implement: an object a switch withdraws must not be recoverable from anything still public -- not its quantity, direction, date or existence -- so everything that depends on, quotes or accumulates from it is withdrawn whole (never rewritten, never replaced by a generated neutral version) and a fixed system label from contracts/openapi/public-v2-system-labels.json stands in its place. The reference consumer (tools/character-episode/src/public_api/gate.rs) reduces every switch to one world-level horizon -- the earliest session in the whole world in which the closed object appears -- and from it on withholds every market-derived object, decided by causal provenance (the canonical events and chassis anchors it was derived from; unknown provenance counts as market-derived); closing a day's reveal therefore looks the same whether or not anything traded that day. Non-market objects (the authored chassis, the observable actions, the natal motif's readings, the memories he arrived with) keep projecting. A missing or unparseable set is read as the fail-closed set, which withdraws every market-derived object from the first session on (the last published set may have closed more than the release-gate default, and it can no longer be read); a consumer must never confuse it with a published revision: published revisions start at 1, and every response records the set it was projected under. Every assertion below is a real one (const, enum, pattern, length, item bounds); `format` is not used. Lists are sets: unique, and the producer writes them in ascending UTF-8 byte order so one set has exactly one serialization (uniqueness is asserted here; ordering is asserted by tools/projection-kill-switch-audit.mjs and by the Rust loader in tools/character-episode/src/public_api/kill_switch.rs, because JSON Schema cannot express it).

revision.description: Monotonic revision of this set. 0 is reserved for the fail-closed set a consumer synthesises when no readable set exists, so a published set starts at 1.

issuedAt.description: When this revision was issued, RFC 3339 with the fixed Asia/Taipei offset.

currentMarketProjection.description: The whole current-market projection: everything from the first session derived from a current-mode (modeDomain "current") world fact manifest, or from a manifest whose mode the consumer cannot establish. Default closed: market-safety.md 發布閘門 keeps it closed until every gate passes. Historical-mode synthetic fixture content is not current-market and is not affected.

tickerSpecificShareAndShortVideo.description: Every ticker-specific share card and 9:16 short video. Default closed.

closedFactRevisionIds.description: Fact revisions whose public projection is withdrawn, from the first session that made visible, attended to, missed, perceived, cited or priced from one of them. Historical fixture ids (fact-...) or upstream sealed-fact ids (sf_...).

closedInstruments.description: Instruments (companies) whose character projection is withdrawn, from the first session whose facts, paper action or holdings concern them.

closedMarketSessionIds.description: Market sessions whose character projection is withdrawn, from that session (or the first session priced from it) on.

closedPaperActionRevealDates.description: Asia/Taipei trading dates whose post-close paper-action reveal is withdrawn, from that day on -- whether or not anything traded that day, so the switch is not an oracle for trading.

closedStoryActIds.description: 今日五幕 acts (world story hooks, by hookId) that are withdrawn.
